surfaced_pitfalls.subject: lock-free read conflicts under a continuous writer
surfaced_pitfalls.detail: Tip doc check-links reads exit 12 (RETRYABLE_CONFLICT) in 5.1% of N=1 and 3.2% of N=8 reads beside a back-to-back writer; 1,356 of 1,593 failures report 'Failed to read configuration' although the writer never changes configuration. Reconcile against epic REQ-21 (bounded refused attempts, then locked fallback vs D-25 retryable conflict) before the epic gate; at minimum the diagnostic misattributes the cause.
